instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Apply the provided Tailwind-equivalent utility classes using NativeWind or via StyleSheet constants that match the design intent.
The UI should look like a premium 'Swiss' utility: strict alignment, high contrast (black and white with very sparse color accents for statuses), and clean 1px borders.
Avoid heavy shadows. Rely on 'Optical Clarity' and 1px borders to separate elements.
For the main 'Repaired' and 'Delivered' statuses, use the green and slate accent colors respectively.
WhatsApp buttons must use a distinct WhatsApp Green (#25D366).
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, list items) use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with active feedback.
The App Header/Navigation should have a stark white background with bold black text. No translucent generic mobile headers.
CRITICAL: Implement `testID` (the React Native equivalent of `data-testid`) on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., testID="new-customer-submit-button").
